operator_io_quirks: Mixed-case table names (Country, Series, CountryNotes, Footnotes, Indicators, SeriesNotes) and mixed-case columns (CountryCode vs Countrycode, SeriesCode vs Seriescode) — case-insensitive column lookup required; FK child col 'Countrycode' -> parent 'CountryCode' differs only in case.
Indicators has 5,656,458 rows (> max_rows_per_table 300000): read_schema must sample by rowid % k = 0; original_sizes must still be full count(*).
Footnotes 532,415 rows also exceeds cap; Year stored as TEXT 'YR1990' style (not a date) — String fuzzer, not Date.
Indicators.Year is INTEGER with values 1961..2016 (year-like ints) but declared INTEGER -> Number fuzzer, not Year/Date; queries comparing Year to 2000 will get perturbed ints.
CountryNotes/Footnotes/Indicators/SeriesNotes have composite PKs (2-3 cols) -> composite-PK member max_l0=30 path; PK dedup must use full tuple.
FK child columns are NOT NULL (Countrycode, Seriescode, CountryCode) but upstream draws NULL when parent empty; those rows fail insert and are skipped — expected, keep.
Series.OtherNotes, OtherWebLinks, RelatedIndicators are INTEGER with 100% NULL (distinct=0): Number sampler gets empty element list -> p:=1, pure fresh draws; original_values all None dropped.
Country has 30 columns, many TEXT with empty-string values ('' appears as a real value, e.g. SpecialNotes, IncomeGroup) — String sampler must treat '' as an element, not NULL.
AlternativeConversionFactor contains non-ASCII bytes ('1991\x96\x96') — String fuzzer must not choke; sqlite text storage.
Country.Alpha2Code distinct=245 < 247 rows (duplicate 2-char codes) — not declared unique, so no dedup; ties exist in original.
Indicators.CountryCode distinct=13 (only 13 countries present) while Country has 247 — FK parent has many unused values; child draws from parent's generated values, not original.
No views/triggers in DDL; all FKs resolve (parent_exists true) — no dangling-FK drop path exercised here, but self-FK/cycle code still must be safe.
operator_ts_expectations: All TEXT columns -> String fuzzer: random a-zA-Z0-9() strings length 0..20, plus 5 sampled originals, plus 50% contaminate (prefix/suffix/drop char). Country names, Series codes, descriptions all become gibberish.

Indicators.Year / Value, Country.Latest*Data -> Number fuzzer (int): uniform in [-10^scale,10^scale] with scale from type args (none -> default), then +-1/+-2 perturbation; Year values like 1961 become arbitrary ints, breaking year-range predicates.

Series.OtherNotes/OtherWebLinks/RelatedIndicators (all-NULL INTEGER) -> Number with no elements -> p=1, always fresh random ints; original had only NULL so any non-NULL is a new value (fine, not a violation).
Footnotes.Year and SeriesNotes.Year are TEXT 'YR####' -> String fuzzer; queries filtering Year='YR2000' will mostly miss because fresh strings dominate (p=0.2 element reuse).

Composite PKs (CountryNotes, Footnotes, Indicators, SeriesNotes) get max_l0=30 cap on fresh draws -> heavy reuse of a small fresh pool, producing many duplicate PK tuples that get dropped by sample_fresh_primary_keys, shrinking tables.

FK consistency: CountryNotes/Footnotes/Indicators/SeriesNotes child FK values drawn from parent's FINAL filtered column with replacement -> many-to-one, ties created; but parent (Country 247, Series 1345) may be smaller than child size -> heavy duplication.

Indicators size likely capped at 2500 (level-based) or ~230 (rand_lin) — far below 5.6M original; joins Country x Indicators produce tiny results, so COUNT/aggregate gold queries may return 0 or small numbers -> FN risk from implausible emptiness.
String contaminate + fresh strings mean LIKE '%...%' predicates rarely match original substrings -> gold queries with LIKE on names/descriptions likely return empty in TS instance (FN).
Number perturbation (+-1/+-2) on Year means equality Year=2000 rarely holds; range predicates (Year BETWEEN 1990 AND 2000) survive better -> mixed FN.

Empty-string values in many Country TEXT columns are real elements; String sampler keeps them, so IS NULL vs ='' distinction preserved somewhat, but fresh strings add non-empty values -> FP risk for '= ''' predicates.
No Date/Time/Bool/Bit columns in this DB — Date/Time fuzzers unexercised; all dispatch is String or Number.
Duplicate Alpha2Code (245 distinct/247 rows) and duplicate ShortName possible -> queries relying on uniqueness of non-PK columns may see ties in TS (FP) or miss ties (FN) depending on draw.
